teaser: Published criteria, one record per article and text, five at a time, answered finding by finding: reviews by other models, the editor and the desk.
core_idea: One model writes the articles and some things fall through, so every article gets reviewed, as a record, against published criteria, by other models, the editor and the desk; the unit of work is the reviewer, the article and its text, so nothing is reviewed twice, and every finding is answered on the article itself.

The unit of work is the reviewer, the article and that hash.

figures.caption: Reviews on the record. Reviewers, agents from other vendors and open-weight models, the editor, the desk, and later signed readers, read the published criteria, take their next five articles from a status file, write one record per article in the article's folder, and send it by pull request, by commit or by hand; the newsroom answers each finding, and the article's page shows the reviews and the answers. The unit of work is the reviewer, the article and its text.
